title: Mochizuki Honami — Noise Gives Way To Silence〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Wait, a ticket to the Miku concert?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Yes. I'm sorry to bring it up so suddenly.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <The truth is, I've sort of been wanting to attend the show you were talking about, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, every ticket site I looked at was sold out...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <And it sounds like they don't have any plans to add extra seats.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Which is why I decided to call you.
I was wondering if you knew of any other ways.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Now I understand.
Hmm... They don't always sell tickets the day of...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Oh! I think they've set up a resale system this time around.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Wait, really?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Yeah. I'm fairly certain that there's an official way to...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Here it is! And they have one left...!
I just sent you the link.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <It's first come first serve, so you might want to hurry...!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Okay! Let's see...
Select the ticket, enter in my name and phone number...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Oh, I got it! I got it, Ichika...!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Thank goodness...! That was a close one.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Yes, but I can attend the concert now. Thank you for showing me what to do, Ichika...!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <You're welcome. I'm so happy that we get to see a Miku concert together, Honami...!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'll send over where we need to meet later. Let me know if you have any questions.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Thank you. Talk to you later.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness I decided to ask Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Now I can go to that concert...
I hope this allows me to learn more about how VIRTUAL SINGER fans feel.
Weekend
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Okay, I should be all warmed up now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I really need to focus today since I'm going to see that concert with Ichika later tonight...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning, Saki. Are you also here to practice on your own?
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I felt like practicing over here today!
Still, Hona, you're here super early!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I decided to get an early start since I have to end things a little early this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, because you and Ichi are going to see that concert!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was kinda surprised when I heard that you'd also be going, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was a very sudden decision on my part. And it's not like I go every time like Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I plan on seeing how the audience reacts during today's concert.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The audience?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. Thanks to Shiho, I've been able to get a better understanding of what people think and feel when they go to see shows at live houses...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still don't really have a good understanding of how VIRTUAL SINGER fans feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, if we do choose to write a song for the Fan Festival...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to see what kinds of people will hear it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I believe in you, Hona!
I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, let me know if there's anything I can do to help!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I could buy some special recovery items for you! Like freshly baked apple pies!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, when I feel like having something sweet, then I'll place an order with you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You got it! I'll deliver whatever you want to wherever you are, Hona♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you were still in the middle of practice...! Sorry, I didn't mean to talk for so long!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay. If anything, Saki, you really helped energize me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's good to hear...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna head over to a different classroom. Let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The others are always giving me so much support...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to do my best. I have to do everything I can, learn as much as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And make a proper decision...which event we're writing the new song for.)
